items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: He was a very dear friend of mine. ... And he was my very dear friend when I did the show with him.

ctx.x: “Autumn in New York.” © Fillius Jazz Archive -22-

Right. I’m not through yet. When I couldn’t think of any more songs with A, then I went to B. All right let me do “Autumn in New York” good song. You know who wrote that, don’t you? The same man who wrote “I Can’t Get Started.” Vernon Duke. Do you know his real name? He was a very dear friend of mine. I did a Broadway show with him called “Sweet By and By.” Put that down in your liner notes. The show never came to New York. We played New Haven, Connecticut, we played Philadelphia, we played Boston. The show…
